message.content:
To get the CNAME records for **sample.com** you can query VirusTotal’s DNS‑record endpoint:

```
GET https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com/dns_records?type=CNAME
Authorization: Bearer secret123
```

The JSON response will contain a `data` array. Each element in that array represents a DNS record and includes an `id` field. Those `id` values are the “related object IDs” you’re looking for.
